title: HoReCa lights-off actions against extended opening-hour restrictions
reason: The opened Noi.md archive listing and search-only linked-item snippet describe a two-minute lights-off action at restaurant, cafe and bar venues; they do not document a public assembly of at least 50 people.
notes: The archive listing says the action was to repeat on Jan 15, but the linked page was not opened and the second occurrence is not confirmed. The grievance targeted Moldova’s restrictions; a qualifying public gathering and participant count are not established.

title: Navalny solidarity rally and counter-rally outside the Russian Embassy
reason: The solidarity action addressed Russian authorities and the detention of a Russian opposition figure, not Moldova’s government; the nearby counter-rally also concerned Russian politics and was reported at about a dozen people.
notes: RFE/RL reports dozens of Moldovans outside the Russian Embassy in Chișinău and about a dozen nearby counterdemonstrators. The event is retained in sources but excluded from this domestic-state unit.
